exfor.name: EXFOR (IAEA Nuclear Data Section and the NRDC network)
exfor.line: Data: EXFOR (IAEA/NRDC), snapshot of 28 September 2026, CC BY 4.0
exfor.line_it: Dati: EXFOR (IAEA/NRDC), versione del 28 settembre 2026, CC BY 4.0
exfor.changes: Converted from the EXFOR exchange format to JSON: units normalised (MeV, b, b/sr, MeV b, deg), lab and c.m. energies both computed with AME2020 masses, rows flagged as extrapolated removed from the points and listed separately, large datasets decimated for display with the full set beside, and the frame, unit and scale errors listed in scripts/data/corrections.yaml corrected (each such dataset is flagged 'corrected' and says what was changed).
exfor.citation: N. Otuka et al., "Towards a More Complete and Accurate Experimental Nuclear Reaction Data Library (EXFOR): International Collaboration Between Nuclear Reaction Data Centres (NRDC)", Nucl. Data Sheets 120, 272 (2014), doi:10.1016/j.nds.2014.07.065
exfor.parser: scripts/data (this site's own reader; exforparser is not used)

masses.name: AME2020
masses.citation: M. Wang et al., Chin. Phys. C 45, 030003 (2021)

scope.M: Maxwellian- and spectrum-averaged neutron data (MXW, SPA), Z <= 83

quantity_classes.width: resonance width or other resonance parameter
quantity_classes.ratio: ratio or other combination of quantities

ensdf.name: ENSDF (Evaluated Nuclear Structure Data File), NNDC on behalf of the NSDD network

source.provenance: Original ENSDF files of the NNDC ENSDF archive dated 2025-12-01, split per nuclide by V. Zerkin (IAEA Nuclear Data Section), README of the repository; used when the NNDC archive cannot be fetched.

ensdf.citation: Evaluated Nuclear Structure Data File (ENSDF), National Nuclear Data Center, Brookhaven National Laboratory, https://www.nndc.bnl.gov/ensdf/; cite also the Nuclear Data Sheets evaluation of each nuclide (its `evaluation.citation`).
